races.paceDynamic: Itsonlyrockandroll will take the field along as the sole confirmed leader in this small field, setting sustainable fractions without early pressure. The prominent Moon Is Up may track behind but has shown a tendency to fade in the finish. With most of the field comprising hold-up horses (Forever Perfect, Corduroy, Crown Inn To Win, Steel Fixer), they'll be relying on the leaders to provide a target. This race shape strongly favors the front-running style, as Itsonlyrockandroll can dictate terms without being pressed early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Itsonlyrockandroll gets an easy lead without early pressure from Moon Is Up
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too controlled for the hold-up brigade to make up ground effectively. Itsonlyrockandroll kicks clear in the straight while the closers struggle to bridge the gap on the testing 1m4f trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Revival
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine enough to set up the race for closers
scenarios.body: Crown Inn To Win and Forever Perfect can use their proven stamina over this C&D to mount late challenges. The front-runner ties up in the final furlong, allowing the patient tactics to pay dividends.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Moon Is Up overcomes his finishing concerns and travels kindly behind the leader
scenarios.body: Jack Callan can use his claim effectively to get Moon Is Up into a good position. The prominent tracker can pounce when Itsonlyrockandroll begins to weaken, avoiding the traffic issues that hamper the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If both Itsonlyrockandroll and Moon Is Up go too slow early then stop quickly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint finish where any of the hold-up horses can prevail. Corduroy's recent yard change and third place over C&D could prove decisive in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Steel Fixer looks outclassed on recent form and trainer Brian Ellison's poor 14-day record (0/19) is concerning
Moon Is Up's tendency to fade late could be exposed if he tracks too close to a steady pace set by Itsonlyrockandroll
Crown Inn To Win has been keen in recent runs which may compromise his finishing kick if he gets involved early
Corduroy's 43-day break and yard change adds uncertainty despite his previous C&D form
If Itsonlyrockandroll gets too easy a lead, the hold-up horses may struggle to make up the ground over this staying trip

races.paceDynamic: Smooth Silesie is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the start without early pressure. Binadham and Midnight Call should sit prominently behind the leader, while Em Four, Diomed Spirit, Shalaa Asker and Phoenix Beach will need to come from further back. This creates a sustainable gallop that builds gradually, with the pace likely honest rather than fierce given the single leader. The shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish, as they'll get the run of the race behind an uncontested leader who may weaken late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Dominate Late
scenarios.trigger: If Smooth Silesie sets honest fractions without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The lone leader will weaken in the final furlong as fresher closers unleash telling late kicks. Hold-up horses like Shalaa Asker and Em Four benefit most from this patient tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Binadham or Midnight Call can track the leader perfectly and kick at the right moment
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run on the weakening leader while the back markers are still organising their challenges. This tactical positioning proves decisive in a tightly-run finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Smooth Silesie finds improvement back at 5f and the pace becomes pedestrian early
scenarios.body: The front-runner gets easy early fractions and has enough left to resist late challenges. Her stamina reserves prove crucial when others are making their moves too late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early gallop becomes crawling slow with no pressure on Smooth Silesie
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where tactical positioning matters less than pure speed. The horses with the highest top-speed ratings can overcome poor draws or positions.

watchPoints.text: Smooth Silesie could get uncontested lead and soft fractions - if pace becomes pedestrian she might prove hard to peg back
Watch for Shalaa Asker getting squeezed for room in finish - his best recent efforts have come when getting clear runs late
Midnight Call's jumping up 9lb to career-high mark after latest win - significant test of her true ability level
Phoenix Beach has course form but all four wins came from marks in the 60s, now rated 57 but carrying just 118lbs

races.paceDynamic: The Bay Warrior is the only confirmed front runner and will dictate a moderate early pace, with Phyllis Burton the only other prominent runner offering token support. The lack of early speed means The Bay Warrior can bowl along uncontested, setting sustainable fractions through the first mile before the race develops. The majority of this field (Rubellite, Three Yorkshiremen, Wave Rock, Knight Of Magic, Beaune, Late Claim) are hold-up horses who will need the pace to collapse in the final 3-4 furlongs. This pace scenario strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems behind.

races.paceDynamic: Havana Joy is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate a steady, uncontested early gallop over this 6f trip. With Crystal Dagger the only prominent runner to provide mild company, the pace will be manageable rather than fierce. The majority field of hold-up horses (Tabby, Daytona Lady, Filly Foden, Star Marian) will be bunched behind, setting up a sprint finish from the 2f pole. This moderate early pace clearly favours the closers who can unleash their finishing kicks from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Havana Joy sets her usual steady pace uncontested through the early stages
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop allows the strong contingent of hold-up runners to conserve energy and produce their best finishing efforts in the final 2f. Star Marian and Filly Foden can utilize their proven finishing speed most effectively.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Running Pays
scenarios.trigger: If Havana Joy finds more improvement than her recent poor form suggests and gets easy fractions
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader builds a decisive advantage that the hold-up horses cannot reel in despite the modest pace. Crystal Dagger could also benefit from tracking the winner throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Star Marian Follows Up
scenarios.trigger: If the recent 5f maiden winner handles the step up to 6f and higher grade effectively
scenarios.body: Her front-running tactics from three weeks ago translate into prominent positioning here, allowing her to capitalize when others struggle with the pace scenario. The 6lb rating rise may not stop her momentum.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both Havana Joy and Crystal Dagger fail to show their usual early pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a crawling affair that turns into an all-out sprint from the 3f marker, suiting the horse with the most natural speed. This chaotic finish could catch out some of the usual hold-up merchants.

watchPoints.text: Havana Joy's early pace will be critical - if she goes too slowly it hands the race to closers, too quickly and she stops
Star Marian's ability to handle both the 6f trip and 6lb rating rise after her front-running 5f maiden win three weeks ago
Crystal Dagger's positioning in the early stages - whether she presses Havana Joy or drops back could shape the entire race
Filly Foden's tactical approach given her speed-focused wins came over 5f and she may struggle when held up over this longer trip
Tabby's fitness after 478 days off the track, despite showing promise in juvenile maidens for her previous trainer

races.paceDynamic: Faster Bee is the sole confirmed front runner and will be allowed to dictate terms from the gates. runners_data.spotlight: Poor strike-rate (1-30); beaten a neck over 6f at Southwell (Class 6) in February but less productive in three subsequent appearances (6f-7f), although with mitigating circumstances (saddle slipped) latest.

runners_data.name: Bad Habits
runners_data.note: Only front-runner gets dream draw to dictate pace, recent near-misses show she's ready to strike
runners_data.comment: Poor strike-rate (1-27) but has twice been edged out in tight finishes recently; possible.
runners_data.spotlight: Poor strike-rate (1-27) but has twice been edged out in tight finishes recently, latterly when failing to reel in Gladiadora at Southwell (7f; 9-1); pestered for the lead, reportedly running "too free", when disappointing over C&D 11 days ago; possible.

runners_data.name: Ravenglass
runners_data.note: Course winner returns from long break, hold-up style problematic but class edge if finding room
runners_data.comment: 1lb lower than when fourth over C&D (25-1) last October; let the market offer a guide.
runners_data.spotlight: Two course wins, including when running on well over this trip (Class 6 classified; 9-4 favourite) last March; now rated 1lb lower than when fourth over C&D (25-1) last October; market should guide on seasonal return.

runners_data.name: Top Star
runners_data.note: Consistent placer lacks winning experience, hold-up style suits if pace collapses but unlikely
runners_data.comment: Yet to win (0-10); runner-up to Flicka's Girl over 6f here latest; 7f is the major unknown
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to win (0-10); runner-up in two of his last three starts, keeping-on to chase home the revitalised Flicka's Girl over 6f here (Class 6 classified; 14-1) four weeks ago; tackles 7f for the first time, a risk even though his dam was a Listed-placed 7f AW winner.

runners_data.name: Ashford Hill
runners_data.note: Won after break earlier this year, needs strong pace and luck from hold-up position
runners_data.comment: "Benefited for break" when springing 16-1 surprise at Lingfield (7f) in Jan; mixed since.
runners_data.spotlight: 2-21; said to have "benefited for the break" when returning to spring a 16-1 surprise at Lingfield (7f, Class 6) in January; wasn't far off those same levels when fourth (beaten 3l) back there next time but latest Kempton effort was only a modest one.

runners_data.name: So Chic
runners_data.note: Course and distance winner with tactical speed, best of the closers if getting clear run
runners_data.comment: Dual C&D winner (incl for this rider); lacked for pace when sixth at Lingfield (7f) latest
runners_data.spotlight: Two of her four wins have come over this C&D, partnered by Jack Doughty when running down Coconut Bay in a Class 6 classified (10-1) last March; lacked the pace to figure when sixth (Gundogan fifth; 13-8 favourite) over this trip at Lingfield latest.

runners_data.name: The Cutest
runners_data.note: Maiden stepping up in trip with hood retained, needs everything to go right
runners_data.comment: 12-race maiden; tackles seventh furlong - dam won over 7f-1m - for first time; 1lb 'wrong'
runners_data.spotlight: 12-race maiden; never dangerous sixth over 6f here (beaten over 5l; 80-1) a fortnight ago; regular hood retained tackling a seventh furlong - dam won over 7f-1m - for the first time; competes from 1lb out of the handicap.

runners_data.name: Big Gypsy King
runners_data.note: Fades in finish regularly, hold-up style completely unsuited to likely pace scenario
runners_data.comment: Poor showings in five starts - 6f Flat to 2m1f hurdle - for this trainer; headgear tweaked
runners_data.spotlight: With Paul and Oliver Cole when a comfortable winner at Chelmsford (7f, Class 6; 5-2 favourite) last May; poor showings in five starts - 6f Flat to 2m1f hurdle - for this trainer; no reason to envisage a change of headgear working the oracle.

runners_data.name: Street Dancer
runners_data.note: Lightly raced but beaten far in three starts, huge task from hold-up position
runners_data.comment: Beaten 26l, 19.5l, and 21l respectively in three 7f AW novices/maidens; makes no appeal.
runners_data.spotlight: Cost 32,000gns as a 3yo but has been beaten 26l, 19.5l, and 21l respectively in three 7f AW novices/maidens; is very lowly rated for handicap debut, competing from 15lb out of the handicap; makes no appeal.

races.paceDynamic: Bad Habits will be the sole pace-setter from stall rise, with no other confirmed front-runners to challenge her early. This creates a dream scenario for the prominent runner, allowing her to dictate terms through comfortable fractions without pressure. The field of eight hold-up performers will be bunched behind, creating traffic problems and relying on Bad Habits to collapse late. This race shape heavily favours the early pace-setter and any horse that can track close behind, as the hold-up brigade face a near-impossible task from so far back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Bad Habits gets an easy lead and maintains stamina
scenarios.body: She dictates comfortable splits through 7f without pressure, then has enough left to repel late challenges. The wall of hold-up horses struggle to make inroads from too far back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Rally Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If Bad Habits ties up in the final furlong after setting pace
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses finally get racing room and one with tactical speed can swoop late. Requires Bad Habits to stop dramatically and traffic to clear.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Creates Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Bad Habits stops abruptly and multiple closers charge together
scenarios.body: A messy finish develops with several hold-up horses arriving simultaneously in a driving finish. The one with best recent form and positioning prevails.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Front Two
scenarios.trigger: If an unexpected horse tracks Bad Habits closely from the start
scenarios.body: One of the supposed hold-up horses breaks character and sits second, then outfinishes the leader. Creates a 1-2 for early positioned horses.

races.name: Wolverhampton Holiday Inn Handicap

runners_data.name: Karakula
runners_data.note: Only front runner in field, gets uncontested lead but hasn't won since breakthrough at this course in September
runners_data.comment: C&D winner (from 1lb lower) last September; less effective since; is fresh from a break.
runners_data.spotlight: Kept on well when making the breakthrough over C&D (from 1lb lower) last September; less effective since, losing a shoe when only fourth of five at Kempton (1m3f); it's possible that she'll return fresher off a 167-day absence.

runners_data.name: Distinction
runners_data.note: Hold-up style veteran with higher RPR, showed signs of return to form at Pontefract but trainer struggling for winners
runners_data.comment: Step back in the right direction at Pontefract (fifth); this looks a suitable objective.
runners_data.spotlight: Won from higher marks at Beverley (1m2f, soft) and Kempton (1m3f) last summer; took a step back in the right direction at Pontefract (fifth) a fortnight ago, and this looks a suitable next objective from 2lb lower; P J McDonald is back aboard.

runners_data.name: Kaaranah
runners_data.note: Won last start over course and distance in cheekpieces, proven AW performer but needs to overcome hold-up style disadvantage
runners_data.comment: Back to winning ways in newly applied cheekpieces over C&D latest; a 4lb rise looks fair.
runners_data.spotlight: Caught the eye on penultimate start; justified market support over C&D subsequently (in newly applied cheekpieces), that his first win since September 2023; a 4lb rise looks fair, so he's entitled to be on the premises assuming the headgear continues to have the desired effect.

runners_data.name: Nuptown Girl
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer but trainer Ian Williams has poor recent strike rate and she faces tactical disadvantage

runners_data.name: Eagles Whistle
runners_data.note: Former hat-trick winner now with new trainer, hold-up style suits but recent form mixed over longer trips
runners_data.comment: C&D winner; perhaps found 1m4f too far at Catterick (6-4 fav) a fortnight ago; chance.
runners_data.spotlight: Rattled up a hat-trick for Daragh Bourke (7f-9.5f) earlier in the year; similar level of form since joining this trainer, runner-up over 8.5f here on penultimate start, and perhaps found 1m4f too far at Catterick (6-4 favourite) a fortnight ago; chance.

runners_data.name: Moonlit Cloud
runners_data.note: Longest absence of field at 180 days, well-handicapped after rating drop but needs everything to fall right from rear
runners_data.comment: No win since May 2024 (1m2f, Bath); best watched on return from a six-month absence.
runners_data.spotlight: No win since May 2024 (1m2f, Bath) but she has fallen a long way in the weights as a result; bogged down on heavy ground at Nottingham last October; it's difficult to know what to expect returned to AW (0-11) off a six-month absence.

races.paceDynamic: Karakula is the only confirmed front runner in this small field and will be allowed to dictate terms without early pressure. The other five runners all show hold-up tendencies, meaning Karakula can set a comfortable gallop through the early stages. This creates a tactical advantage for any horse that can track the leader closely, as the lack of pace pressure means the race will likely be decided by who has the most left in the tank from the final two furlongs. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can position themselves within striking distance of the leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Karakula Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Karakula gets an uncontested lead and maintains a steady gallop
scenarios.body: The leader gets first run on the field and holds off late challenges with his proven course form and tactical advantage. The hold-up brigade leaves their runs too late against a horse who hasn't been softened up.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace sets up a sprint finish where class and recent form become decisive factors. Fresh legs triumph over the long-time leader who may have done too much in front.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Wins
scenarios.trigger: If one of the hold-up horses positions closer to Karakula than usual
scenarios.body: A horse breaks from their typical pattern to track the leader more closely, getting first run on the rest of the field. This tactical switch proves decisive in a small field where position matters.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Karakula goes too slowly early and gets swamped by multiple challengers
scenarios.body: The entire field converges in the final furlong creating a cavalry charge finish where anything can happen. The longest-priced runner benefits from the chaos.
